entities.name: Anikthea
entities.description: A demigod of Erebos on Theros, formerly an ambitious monster slayer of Setessa.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: God of the Underworld who took Anikthea.

entities.name: Cirkis
entities.description: Witch of the Despair Lands who served Erebos and was killed by Anikthea.

entities.name: Setessa
entities.description: Polis Anikthea was groomed to lead.

entities.name: Wall of Anikthea
entities.description: Trail of monsters left by Anikthea in the Underworld.

events.summary: Anikthea slays the witch Cirkis, who cursed Setessa's fields.
events.quote: Anikthea claimed the witch's head as proof of her success

events.summary: Erebos steals Anikthea away to Agonas.
events.quote: stole her away to Agonas, dragging her down through the mouth of Cirkis as she slept

events.summary: Erebos pits his champions against her, then offers her freedom if she fights to the surface.
events.quote: offered her a deal: fight her way to the surface and win her freedom

events.summary: Anikthea agrees to serve Erebos if she may protect her people, and becomes a demigod.
events.quote: she would serve Erebos as long as she could return home to protect her people when they needed her most

relations.quote: is a demigod of Erebos on Theros
Anikthea claimed the witch's head as proof of her success
the witch had been working in the service of Erebos
